legacy.claim: On the vacuum background the cubic λ n₊ n₋²/4 term is absent from the linearized principal symbol (λ=0 and λ≠0 agree). A small uniform background mixes the two scalar Hessian speeds. Those spectral conclusions are local; completing the square in n₊ leaves a negative quartic −λ² n₋⁴/(16 c₊²), so global Hamiltonian unboundedness is uncured for every λ≠0.

X0 is rejected for an indefinite Hessian, and the report explicitly retains the exact negative-quartic global-unboundedness result rather than promoting B0 local stability to a cure.
